title: Two new loaches of the genus Mesonoemacheilus from the Western Ghats (Teleostei: Nemacheilidae)
content:
Abstract

Two new species of the ‘Mesonoemacheilus guentheri’ group are described from the Western Ghats Hotspot, based on morphological and multi-locus molecular data (mitochondrial cytochrome oxidase subunit 1, cytochrome b and nuclear Recombination-Activating Gene 1 sequences). Mesonoemacheilus mannanorum, new species, from a headwater stream of the Periyar River, is distinguished by a unique colour pattern of three series of whitish blotches on a brown background, and 8–9 branched pectoral-fin rays. Mesonoemacheilus sabariensis, new species, from a headwater stream of the Pamba River, is distinguished by a unique colour pattern comprising midlateral series of regularly or irregularly set and shaped whitish blotches with a wide brown margin, and pointed, elongated nasal flap-bars. Mesonoemacheilus now comprises 11 species, all of which are endemic to the rivers draining the Western Ghats Biodiversity Hotspot.
